dnf_incident_bound.description: share of all rows whose status_raw is an unambiguous racing incident (['Accident', 'Collision', 'Collision damage', 'Spun off']) or a mechanical failure (34 distinct values); a lower bound, not a variance share

near_identical_teammate_variance.description: Var(finish_A - finish_B)/2 over corpus-wide Var(finish position), for 1540 classified teammate pairs within a 3-position grid gap — identical car, identical circuit, identical day, near-identical starting position

model_error_in_context.note: the model's mean absolute error, read against a floor measured from real near-identical teammate pairs rather than against zero (FR-755, Constitution X.5); a model whose error already sits near the floor has little further room a pre-race model could close
